name: Nippori
tagline: Tokyo in 13 minutes and Otemachi in 19 minutes. Served by 6 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000.
summary: The station is in Arakawa City, where JR East, Keisei and the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation run 6 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 19 minutes to Otemachi, 27 minutes to Shinjuku, 32 minutes to Shibuya and 27 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. The station stands 6.3 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 15.6 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 6.3 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 3.7 m to 19.3 m, a difference of 15.6 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 4 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is 0.5 to 3 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the small side for the 23 wards.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 14 clinics and 19 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is はせがわ病院, about 5 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 神経科土田病院, about 12 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 6 lines serve the station. JR Yamanote Line and JR Joban Line run through it. JR Keihin-Tohoku Line and Keisei Main Line also call here. Narita Sky Access Line are available too. Nippori-Toneri Liner stop here as well. The lines are split between operators (JR East runs 3 lines, Keisei runs 2 lines and the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation runs 1 line), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company.
congestion: JR Keihin-Tohoku Line runs at 159% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 大井町→品川, which this station is not on. JR Joban Line runs at 142% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch of the line is 三河島→日暮里, which includes this station. Keisei Main Line runs at 137%. Its busiest stretch is 大神宮下→京成船橋, which this station is likewise not on. Narita Sky Access Line and Nippori-Toneri Liner is not covered by the ministry's congestion survey. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥90,000 to ¥100,000 and 1K ¥110,000 to ¥120,000. 1LDK ¥170,000 to ¥180,000 and 2LDK ¥220,000 to ¥230,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

Whether it faces a main road or the railway

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is among the lowest in the 23 wards. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Nishi-Nippori is ahead on how easy the shopping is, but Nippori is ahead on the number of lines.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Nippori. Nishi-Nippori has 4 lines, so Nippori is the better connected. To Otemachi, for instance, Nishi-Nippori is 6 minutes quicker. Rents, flood projections and the rest differ little.

neighbours.lead: Sendagi is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection, but Nippori is ahead on the number of lines.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Nippori. Sendagi has only the Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line, so Nippori is the better connected. To Otemachi, for instance, Sendagi is 8 minutes quicker. A one-room flat, though, costs about ¥6,000 less at Sendagi.

notFor: The data does not show a drawback particular to this station
noiseSources: 尾久橋通り (a main road) runs just outside the station. In a flat facing it, the cars are audible morning and evening

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 14 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 3 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: 6 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the lowest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
